messages.subject: GGIR for GeneActiv .csv files
parts:
Hello, 

I am having issues getting an output for a GeneActiv .csv file. Below is the code I entered and the error that I get in response. Any ideas are greatly appreciated. 

read.myacc.csv(rmc.file= "C:/Documents/BPA Geneactiv/Geneactiv2101.csv",
               +                rmc.nrow = Inf,
               +                rmc.skip = 0,
               +                rmc.dec = ".",
               +                rmc.firstrow.acc = 1,
               +                rmc.col.acc = 1:3,
               +                rmc.col.temp = 4,
               +                rmc.col.time=1,
               +                rmc.unit.acc = "g",
               +                rmc.unit.temp = "C",
               +                rmc.unit.time = "POSIX",
               +                rmc.format.time = "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%OS",
               +                desiredtz = "Europe/London",
               +                rmc.sf = 100)
Error: unexpected '=' in:
"read.myacc.csv(rmc.file= "C:/Documents/BPA Geneactiv/Geneactiv2101.csv",
               +                rmc.nrow ="

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] GGIR for GeneActiv .csv files
parts:
Hello Adam,

As of release 2.6-4 GGIR no longer facilitates GENEActiv .csv as it caused too many headaches. Could you please apply GGIR to the GENEActiv .bin files?

The .bin have been consistent in format since 2012, have been extensively tested with GGIR, are fast to read, and are compact in size.

Best,
Vincent
